purpose: Compare model size on the same broad mixture after the current family/source comparison.
selection_rule: Inspect per-family development results, learning curves, actual source-token exposure and speed; choose the mixture before running the size comparison. Do not select on the external final tests.

small_model.data: Select one of the frozen data-families or data-sources views using the rule above.
small_model.evaluation: Use the unchanged broad-checks-2026-09-07 suite and report by capability.

longer_training.selection_rule: Continue only if held-out capability metrics or loss still improve; compare validation trends against training loss to detect memorization.
longer_training.schedule_requirement: Define a new explicit continuation schedule; do not silently extend an expired deadline or restart the decayed learning rate.
longer_training.external_final_tests: Remain closed until the final model and protocol are frozen.
